name: mcal_create_calendar
description: Create a new calendar for the account. `name` is the human label; `slug` is an optional URL-safe id (lowercase letters, digits, dashes) — if omitted it is derived from the name. Slugs must be unique within the account (409 if taken). Requires the calendar:write scope (403 otherwise). Returns the created calendar including its `slug`.

slug.description: Optional URL-safe id (lowercase, digits, dashes). Derived from name if omitted.
